guarantees.claim: When state is StPad and next state is StPad01, end_of_block must be low
When keccak_valid_o is asserted, keccak_addr_o is less than KeccakRate[strength_i]

assumptions.claim: When msg_valid_i and msg_ready_o are both high, process_valid must be high and process_i must be low
assumptions.risk: If violated, the process might start while another is ongoing, leading to data corruption
process_i asserted without process_valid could indicate a deadlocked or misaligned handshake
Starting the pad without a valid start condition may lead to undefined state

assumptions.claim: When done_i passes mubi4 true strict check, done_valid must be high
assumptions.risk: A true done signal not reflected in done_valid could permanently halt the operation

assumptions.claim: Any change in mode_i must coincide with start_valid
assumptions.risk: Mode change mid-operation could cause the pad to process data with wrong algorithm, leading to cryptographic failure

assumptions.claim: Any change in strength_i must coincide with start_valid
assumptions.risk: Strength change mid-operation could corrupt the absorption phase and produce wrong digest

assumptions.claim: At start_i, mode_i and strength_i must be a valid combination: SHA3 with 224/256/384/512, or SHAKE/cSHAKE with 128/256
assumptions.risk: An invalid mode/strength combination may bypass critical padding or absorption rules, potentially revealing secret material or causing functional deadlock

assumptions.claim: When keccak_valid_o and MuxFifo selected, all bits of msg_strb_i must be 1 (no partial strobe in FIFO mode)
assumptions.risk: A partial write into the FIFO could leave stale bytes, leading to incorrect keccak input

assumptions.claim: When en_msgbuf is asserted, msg_valid_i must be high and the most significant byte of msg_strb_i must be 0 (always a partial write)
assumptions.risk: If a full write occurs into the message buffer, it may overwrite necessary partial state and cause data loss

assumptions.claim: After accepting a partial message (msg_valid_i, msg_ready_o, msg_partial), msg_valid_i must be deasserted on the next cycle and stay deasserted until process_latched rises
assumptions.risk: If another message arrives before process_latched, it could be misinterpreted as part of the same partial block, breaking message boundaries

uncertain_points.claim: The assumption that ns_data_i must be stable during the operation (line 874-877) is commented out with no replacement, leaving the stability requirement unchecked
uncertain_points.cond: Unknown if the design still expects ns_data_i stability; current RTL has no enforcement
uncertain_points.risk: If ns_data_i changes during processing, the keccak nonce could be corrupted, potentially compromising security or producing wrong results without detection
